description: Add a getVADStats() function to src/vad.js that returns an object with speechCount (number of speech events detected) and totalSpeechMs (cumulative ms of detected speech) tracked since the AdaptiveVAD was created

contract.raw_request: Add a getVADStats() function to src/vad.js that returns an object with speechCount (number of speech events detected) and totalSpeechMs (cumulative ms of detected speech) tracked since the AdaptiveVAD was created
contract.goal: Add a function getVADStats() to src/vad.js that returns an object containing speechCount and totalSpeechMs. This function should track the number of speech events detected and the cumulative milliseconds of detected speech since the AdaptiveVAD was created.
required_behavior: The getVADStats() function is added to src/vad.js
The function returns an object with speechCount (number of speech events detected) and totalSpeechMs (cumulative ms of detected speech)
The function tracks speech events since the AdaptiveVAD was created
constraints: The getVADStats() function is added to src/vad.js
The function does not interfere with existing code in src/vad.js

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The getVADStats() function is present in src/vad.js
The getVADStats() function returns an object with speechCount and totalSpeechMs
The getVADStats() function tracks speech events since the AdaptiveVAD was created

verification_plan: Verify the presence of the getVADStats() function in src/vad.js
Verify the return type and structure of the function
Verify the function's implementation logic for tracking speech events
